The world is racing to “save the planet,” but is that really what God has called us to do? In this explosive video, we expose the climate change agenda through the lens of Bible prophecy and the end times. As wildfires rage and extreme weather events increase, many Christians are missing the real message—these are the very signs Jesus warned about in Matthew 24.

While the world fights to extend its stay on a dying planet, Scripture calls us to something greater: recognize the signs, turn to Christ, and prepare the world for His soon return. This isn’t about going green—it’s about waking up.

📖 What does the Bible say about climate change, natural disasters, and the last days?
🌍 Is the global climate agenda preparing the world for something prophetic?
⏳ Are we reacting the wrong way while prophecy is being fulfilled right before our eyes?

Don’t get distracted. Understand the signs. Prepare for what’s coming.
